apps.name: TamaEmu
apps.subtitle: Tamagotchi emulator
apps.localizedDescription: An iOS emulator for Tamagotchi-family devices. Does not include any firmware/ROM — bring your own.

versions.localizedDescription: Opt-in reminder notification, an Appearance setting replacing the separate color pickers, Mute toggle removed in favor of the volume slider, button tray polish, and a bolder ambient-mode device label.
Multi-Tama swipeable gallery with drag-to-reorder, full-bleed ambient background during play, widget picker fix, perceptual volume curve, and a Plus Color animation/tempo tuning pass.
